lines.text: For three years, Sam's phone wallpaper was the same red rock arch in Utah.
Every spring, he said next year.
The trip felt too big: five parks, long drives, shuttles and permits.
So his partner gave him the plan.
Drive times between the parks, three, five and seven-day routes, and the day hikes ready on his phone.
Now the trip is on the calendar for spring.
Save this if Utah is on your list.
